title: event mic.grab: data
description: A user took a mic slot. Camfrog: the ONSET of the s2c 0x16 holder heartbeat (the ~6/s repeats are not forwarded). Rooms can be multi-mic; 'holders' is the full holder set after this grab. The bot's own grab is emitted by the connector from its own command (Camfrog never echoes it).

session.description: Platform mic-session id if any (Camfrog: 4-byte id, hex).

holders.description: Everyone holding a mic slot after this event.

slots.description: Mic slots in this room, if known.
